ai_analysis.summary: Strong technical alignment on systems programming, Linux kernel work, and hardware interfacing (drivers, SPI, UART, ASIC-level work at Arista), but the job title 'Senior Engineer' clashes with a candidate explicitly seeking a first graduate role — a clear seniority mismatch. The job posting itself is a placeholder with almost no real requirements, so this assessment leans heavily on the candidate's stated context rather than the job text.
resume_tips: Add explicit 'Linux kernel driver development' keyword near the top since it directly matches hardware-interface systems roles.
Quantify the Arista ASIC register work (e.g., number of registers, chips supported, code generation scope) to show production-grade impact.
Clarify graduate/entry-level positioning in the profile summary since job titles like 'Senior Engineer' may filter out junior candidates via ATS seniority parsing.
Move RFID Driver, My Docker, and Linux System Tracing projects higher on the resume — they best demonstrate kernel/OS-level competence.
Add 'device drivers' and 'syscalls' as explicit keywords since several projects (RFID driver, container runtime) implicitly use them but don't state them.

MSc in Computer Engineering (EPITA - GISTRE) in Systems / Embedded. Fluent in French and English (TOEIC 915, C1). Interests: watchmaking, music, hiking/running, cooking.
